At the bottom of Edron's Hero Cave there are two chests with rings. You cross the cave full of {creature:Hero|Heroes} and other human and magical creatures, following the route map, and open the chests to receive a {item:Time Ring} and a {item:Sword Ring}.

If you're not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive at Edron's harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. From the harbour, head **north** to the entrance of the {wiki:Hero Cave}, north of the city, and go in.

Follow the route on the map below, image by image, to the chests. Along the way you will meet {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Dark Apprentice|Dark Apprentices}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Hero|Heroes}.
Full route through the Hero Cave to the ring chests
In the area of image no. 6 you will probably need {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireballs} or {item:Thunderstorm Rune|Thunderstorms} to clear the way.
Use the chests at the end of the route to receive the rewards.

Go back the **same way**: retrace the map route in reverse, use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through and climb the stairs you came up by, until you reach the Hero Cave entrance. Outside, head **south** to the city of **Edron**; to leave the island talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the harbour ({key:hi}, the city name, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
